2026-11-09.title: Monday after Hudos Eetho Sunday · St Theodore
readings: A sabbath rest remains for the people of God
Not one of these little ones should be lost
2026-11-09.alt: St Theodore, soldier and martyr (early 4th century; details of his life come mainly from Tradition).
2026-11-09.verse: So it is not the will of your Father in heaven that one of these little ones should be lost.
theo: Hebrews reads Psalm 95 as a call for today: “O that today you would listen to his voice! Do not harden your hearts.” Israel in the desert did not enter God's rest because of disobedience. But the promise still stands: “a sabbath rest still remains for the people of God.” Every Sunday Qurbono is a foretaste of that rest, and every day is the “today” in which we can listen.

In the Gospel Jesus defends the little ones: children, the weak, the easily forgotten. Their angels always behold the Father's face. The shepherd leaves the ninety-nine to look for the one that strayed, and rejoices more over it than over the rest. The Father does not want even one of them to be lost. A parish is judged by how it seeks the one who is missing.

homily: Dear friends, on this Monday after Hudos Eetho Sunday, Hebrews reads Psalm 95 as a call for today: today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts. Israel in the desert did not enter God's rest because of disobedience; but the promise is still open (Hebrews 4:7–9).

In the Gospel Jesus says: take care that you do not despise one of these little ones; for in heaven their angels continually see the face of my Father. Like a shepherd who goes after one lost sheep, it is not the will of the Father in heaven that one of these little ones should be lost (Matthew 18:10–14).

Today is the day to listen. Do today the conversion, the reconciliation or the prayer you have put off till tomorrow. And let us protect children and the weak, as the angels of God protect them. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus said every child has a guardian angel. Pray to your guardian angel today!
